title: Form
description: Schema for an EventConductor form definition JSON file.

id.description: Unique identifier. Auto-generated on import if omitted.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the form.

fields.description: Ordered list of fields that make up the form.

id.description: Field identifier, unique within this form.

dataType.description: Data type of the field value.

stereotype.description: Visual / input stereotype that determines how the field is rendered. Defaults to 'regular' when omitted.

required.description: Whether the user must provide a value for this field before submitting the form.

description.description: Optional hint or help text shown below the field.

options.description: The choices this field offers, in the order they are shown, for the stereotypes that pick from a list: radio, select, combobox, listBox, choice. The value is what the form submits and what the process variable ends up holding; the label is what the user reads. Absent or empty means the field takes free input.

value.description: What the form submits when this option is picked. Unique within the field.

label.description: What the user reads. Defaults to the value when omitted.

optionsSource.description: Where the choices come from instead, when they are not written into the definition: a REST endpoint the browser calls as the form renders, so the field offers what a catalogue or directory says right now. The engine only carries this descriptor — it never calls the endpoint on its own, and unless proxy is set the fetch is the browser's, so the endpoint must be reachable from it and allow CORS. Declare either options or optionsSource, never both.

url.description: The endpoint. Supports ${state.x} interpolation against the form's own values, so one field's choices can depend on another's answer and refetch when it changes.

headers.description: Request headers, values interpolated. Without proxy the browser makes the call and can read these, so a credential belongs here only as a ${secret.X} placeholder resolved server-side in proxy mode.

body.description: Request body template, interpolated, for non-GET methods.

itemsPath.description: Dot path to the array inside the response (data.countries). Blank means the response root is the array.

valuePath.description: Dot path within each item to the option value.

labelPath.description: Dot path within each item to the option label.

proxy.description: Fetch through the server instead of from the browser: no CORS, and a ${secret.X} placeholder in a header or the url is resolved server-side instead of travelling to the client. The server only ever fetches what this stored definition declares.

allOf.$comment: A field declares its choices or where to fetch them, not both. Written against a non-empty options array rather than as a plain not/required, because a serialized field always carries options — as [] when it has none.
